tonight.headline: Up 113.4 to 51.8 and finished; Monday night's Rams decide it
body: Bad news first. Carnell Tate played and caught one of five targets for 1.6, while Matthew Golden, the coin flip behind him, scored 20.3 on your bench. Colston Loveland scored 3.9 and Brenton Strange, the tight end you swapped out for him on Wednesday, scored 13.8. Jonathan Taylor was held to 11.2. Saquon Barkley was inactive with no new date, and Alvin Kamara had five touches that nobody has explained. You left 22.3 points on the bench.

You still lead by 61.6 with only Jason Myers playing. They have Goff, Jeremiyah Love and Kittle in progress and Kyren Williams and Puka Nacua on Monday night; ESPN has it 118.0 to 116.1 and gives you 53%. Your lineup is locked and was the projection lineup. There is nothing to do tonight, and nothing on the wire has a seat to go to.

case.label: Their side
case.body: 51.8 so far: Watson 32.3, Higgins 4.2, the Cowboys' defence 1, Santos 0, and three in progress at the snapshot, Goff 11.5, Love 2.8 and Kittle 0.0. Kittle is playing through an illness (PFT). Kyren Williams, 17.9, and Nacua, 21.7, play Buffalo on Monday night and neither is on the Rams' injury report. They left Jayden Daniels, 29.8, and Isaiah Likely, 32.4, on the bench.

case.label: Your side
case.body: Pickens 28.0, Wilson 23.4, Lawrence 20.7, Tuten 11.6, Taylor 11.2, Myers 10 and counting, Loveland 3.9, the Jaguars 3, Tate 1.6: 113.4. Golden 20.3 and Gordon 14.8 sat.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing of yours. They need about 62 from five players, two of whom are projected for 39.6 between them on Monday. A quiet night for the Rams' pair wins it for you; a normal one makes it a point or two either way.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · Week 5 live archive · lineup_check.py · therams.com · PFT

whatWentWrong.title: The coin flip at receiver lost by 18.7
whatWentWrong.lead: Tate 1.6, Golden 20.3. Tate was active and no exit was reported.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Tate: 1 catch on 5 targets for 6 (live archive). He had no catch in the first half and a long third-quarter catch was called back for holding (Titansized, 15:55 ET), so he was still on the field after half-time. Golden: 6 catches on 7 targets for 123 and a two-point conversion.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: No card. The projection had it 13.6 to 12.8 and the brief took the projection without a thesis, as the rule says. It is recorded as a miss and not as a reason to start Golden next week on this box score.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A snap count showing Tate was limited by the back. Then it was an availability miss, and the question for Week 6 becomes his practice report.

whatWentWrong.sources: Week 5 live archive · Titansized · AP · NBC Sports

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end seat lost again
whatWentWrong.lead: Loveland 3.9, Strange 13.8. The swap was yours on Wednesday, against the brief's order, and its thesis closes WRONG.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Loveland drew 5 targets from Tyson Bagent, who was benched for Case Keenum. Strange caught 7 of 8 for 68, a second straight game with eight targets (archive: 3, 2, 5, 8, 8).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing tonight. The seat has changed hands three times in five days and stays closed until 14 Oct. Strange is on waivers until Wednesday at 01:00, Jacksonville are off in Week 7, and Caleb Williams is 'on track' to throw to Loveland at Atlanta.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuesday's brief, the last before claims: Strange is a claim only if Williams is not starting and the Week 6 projection puts Strange more than two points clear. You are last in the order, so the claim costs nothing and loses to anyone.

whatWentWrong.sources: Week 1–5 archives · packers.com · AP · Bleacher Report

worthALook.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
worthALook.lead: The trade is done: Houston's coach announced it after their game. He is now on waivers here until Wednesday at 01:00, and you are last in the order.

case.label: The news
case.body: DeMeco Ryans, after Houston's win: 'We traded for Marvin Harrison.' Arizona get a 2027 second-round pick and a sixth; Houston also get a 2027 seventh (AP via ABC, 17:06 ET). He was a healthy scratch for Arizona today. Whether he plays in London in Week 6 has not been said.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 13 targets in four games, 3, 1, 5 and 4, for 4.3, 0.0, 7.0 and 8.2 (archive). This morning he was a free agent; once the games began he went onto waivers, where you are tenth of ten. Your bench is Barkley, Rice, Golden, and two backs protected by a team-mate's injury: there is no seat.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday. A claim costs you nothing, because you cannot fall lower than last, but it loses to any rival's. If he clears on Wednesday he is free, and the drop is named then.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same eight names clear the tool's bar, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. Today answered five of the eight, four of them downward. None is a move: you are last in the order and no seat is open.

settled.title: 'Rain showers are likely at Green Bay' (Saturday morning, used against Golden)
settled.result: The National Weather Service has Green Bay sunny, 75 to 79°F. The morning figure came from a site whose labels and percentages disagreed. The Tate-over-Golden call is the projection's and did not rest on it.

settled.title: 'Ladd McConkey doubtful to play' (Friday afternoon, in the Keaton Mitchell note)
settled.result: He is questionable; the doubtful tag belongs to Trey Lance. The game is also Denver at the Chargers, not the reverse. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'Shipley and Pierce expected to share' (Friday afternoon, from the Inquirer)
settled.result: philadelphiaeagles.com, published the same afternoon, expects Shipley 'to be the primary back'. It matters to your Jaguars defence, and the brief used one source when the team's own was available.

settled.title: 'Barkley is trending out' (beat writers, relayed since Tuesday)
settled.result: Ruled out on Friday and not placed on injured reserve. He was on your bench at 0.0 all week, with Tuten in his slot.

settled.title: 'One game does not change next week' on Pickens's 13 targets (Friday morning)
settled.result: Lamb's quad is a bruise, not considered serious, and he should play in Week 6 (Rapoport). The caution stands.

settled.title: 'Nobody has explained Tate's back' (Thursday afternoon)
settled.result: It was explainable within hours: a beat writer watched him tweak it in individual drills. The brief did not find that on Thursday.

settled.title: 'You are 7th of ten, so it will probably fail' (Wednesday's edition)
settled.result: It did not fail. Six managers ahead of you passed on a receiver 99% rostered. The forecast was wrong; the recommendation stood either way.

settled.title: Week 4 final: 63.7 to 78.2
settled.result: Kyle Pitts added 7.7 for Team 13 on Monday (archive). You lost by 14.5. Kamara 22.8, Tate 21.5, Gordon 18.0 and Golden 11.7 on the bench would have scored 61.7 more than the four slots they could have filled. Barkley and Rice were injury exits; the rest was the projection's lineup.

settled.result: Archive: Downs 4.6, Tate 21.5. A coin flip by projection with no thesis written, and it lost by 16.9.

settled.title: 'Darren Waller: do not chase' (Saturday's brief)
settled.result: You added him. Archive: Waller 6.6, Sadiq 0.0. Your move won the week; four days later you dropped him on his bye.

settled.result: Archive: 18.0 on the bench. The lean was mine and it is withdrawn. He projects 10.9 this week and is on your bench behind Tuten, where the projection puts him.
